parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The destination domain name to query. You must specify at least one of Domain or DomainList. If neither is specified, the API returns ErrorDomainName.

parameters.name: DomainList
parameters.description: The list of destination domain names to query. You must specify at least one of Domain or DomainList. If neither is specified, the API returns ErrorDomainName.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

parameters.name: IPType
parameters.description: Queries outbound connections from NAT private IP addresses.

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
